title: Copilot Studio Analytics Configuration
description: Configuration schema for Copilot Studio Analytics Dataverse-to-App Insights sync pipeline

subscription_id.description: Azure subscription ID where Application Insights is deployed

resource_group.description: Azure resource group containing Application Insights

application_insights.description: Application Insights configuration (same workspace as AOF)

workspace_id.description: Log Analytics workspace identifier. Accepts either a GUID (preferred — used directly with LogsQueryClient.query_workspace) or an ARM resource ID (validate_telemetry.py auto-routes ARM IDs through LogsQueryClient.query_resource).

dataverse.description: Dataverse connection settings for reading session data

auth_mode.description: Dataverse authentication mode. Prefer managed identity or workload identity; client-secret is a legacy development fallback.

tenant_id.description: Entra ID tenant ID, required for workload identity, certificate, interactive, and legacy client-secret auth

client_id.description: App registration client ID for workload identity, certificate, interactive, and legacy client-secret auth

managed_identity_client_id.description: Optional user-assigned managed identity client ID. Omit for system-assigned managed identity.

certificate_path.description: Optional certificate path for certificate authentication

lookback_buffer_hours.description: Safety buffer in hours for late-arriving sessions

tier.description: Sync tier: 1 = msdyn_botsession only, 2 = adds transcript parsing

batch_size.description: Number of records per App Insights batch

business_impact.description: Business impact calculation defaults for cost/time savings

conversational.description: Settings for conversational agent impact calculation

time_savings_minutes.description: Minutes saved per knowledge source reference or weighted session

resolved_no_ks_weight.description: Weight multiplier for resolved sessions without knowledge source

escalated_abandoned_no_ks_weight.description: Weight multiplier for escalated/abandoned sessions without knowledge source

autonomous.description: Settings for autonomous agent impact calculation

info_retrieval_time_saving_minutes.description: Minutes saved per knowledge source reference

generic_time_saving_minutes.description: Minutes per successful session without independent actions

action_multipliers.description: Tier 2: per-action-type multipliers (action name to minutes)

hourly_rate.description: USD hourly rate for Agent Assisted Cost calculation

zone_mapping.description: Governance zone mapping from environment URL prefix to zone name
